heading.zh-Hant: 戰前的師、軍團長與出任總參謀長
heading.en: Pre-war divisions, army corps and appointment as chief of staff

body.zh-Hant: 卡多爾納1905年升中將，先後指揮安科納師（1905–07年）與那不勒斯師。1908年，總參謀長一職由波利奧接任，卡多爾納落選；1910年他出任熱那亞軍團指揮官，1913年被任命為王國參議員。1914年7月27日他接任陸軍總參謀長。
body.en: Cadorna became a lieutenant general in 1905 and commanded the Ancona division and then the Naples division. In 1908 the post of chief of staff went to General Pollio, not to him; in 1910 he took command of the Genoa army corps and in 1913 was named a senator of the Kingdom. On 27 July 1914 he assumed the post of chief of the army general staff.

citations.quote: tenente generale nel 1905, ebbe il comando della divisione di Ancona (1905-07)
e di quella di Napoli (1907-09)
apprendeva la nomina all'alto incarico del gen. A. Pollio
Nel 1910 il C. assumeva il comando del corpo d'armata di Genova
Nel 1913 veniva nominato senatore del Regno.
Il 27 luglio egli assumeva l'alto incarico

heading.en: 1915–1917: the Isonzo front

body.zh-Hant: 1915年5月24日，卡多爾納以三十五個師開始對奧匈軍隊作戰。他的戰略重心在伊松佐河，來源稱前後共十一次戰役；1916年5月奧軍在特倫蒂諾發動攻勢，他仍在同年8月奪下戈里齊亞；1917年8月的巴伊西察戰役使奧匈瀕臨崩潰。
body.en: On 24 May 1915 Cadorna opened operations against the Austro-Hungarian forces with thirty-five divisions. His effort centred on the Isonzo, in what the source counts as eleven battles. Despite the Austro-Hungarian offensive in the Trentino in May 1916 he took Gorizia in August 1916, and the Bainsizza battle of August 1917 pushed Austria-Hungary to the brink of collapse.

citations.quote: Il 24 maggio 1915 il C. iniziava le operazioni contro le truppe austro-ungariche
sull'Isonzo (undici battaglie complessive)
dall'offensiva austro-ungarica del Trentino (maggio 1916)
strappava al nemico Gorizia (agosto 1916)
(battaglia della Bainsizza, agosto del 1917)

heading.en: Caporetto and removal from command

body.zh-Hant: 1917年10月24日，奧德聯軍第十四集團軍突破義軍防線。卡多爾納在10月27日發出公報，把潰敗歸咎於第二集團軍部隊，隨後才下令撤退；撤至皮亞韋河後他下令死守。11月9日他被迪亞茲接替，並被任命為協約國最高軍事委員會成員。
body.en: On 24 October 1917 the Austro-German 14th Army broke through the Italian lines. On 27 October Cadorna issued a bulletin blaming units of the Second Army, and only then ordered the retreat; once the Piave was reached he ordered resistance to the end. On 9 November he was replaced by Diaz and named a member of the Inter-Allied Supreme War Council.

citations.quote: armata austrotedesca sfondò le linee italiane
il 27 ottobre diramò un bollettino
diramava gli ordini relativi solo il 27 mattina
lanciava l'ordine di resistenza ad oltranza
Il 9 novembre il C. era perciò sostituito con Diaz
nominato membro del Consiglio superiore di guerra interalleato

heading.en: After the war: inquiry, marshal's baton and death

body.zh-Hant: 1918年2月17日，卡多爾納被緊急召回義大利，等候卡波雷托調查委員會；1919年9月他被列入退役。1924年11月4日，墨索里尼晉封他與迪亞茲為義大利元帥；他重返參議院，1928年12月21日在博爾迪蓋拉逝世。
body.en: On 17 February 1918 Cadorna was suddenly recalled to Italy and placed at the disposal of the commission of inquiry into Caporetto, and in September 1919 he was retired. On 4 November 1924 Mussolini named him and Diaz Marshals of Italy; he returned to the Senate and died at Bordighera on 21 December 1928.

citations.quote: il 17 febbr. 1918 fu improvvisamente richiamato in Italia
commissione d'inchiesta nominata dal governo Orlando
nel settembre 1919 il C., che un anno prima era passato in posizione ausiliaria
Il 4 nov. 1924 Mussolini volle troncare le discussioni sulla guerra
nominando il C. e Diaz marescialli d'Italia
Morì il 21 dic. 1928 in Bordighera

heading.en: 1909–1914: staff service and the Libyan war

body.zh-Hant: 1909年10月，迪亞茲被任命為佛羅倫斯師參謀長；1910年7月1日升上校，指揮拉斯佩齊亞的第21步兵團。1912年5月他赴利比亞接替第93步兵團團長，9月20日在紮努爾附近的西迪比拉勒戰鬥中肩部中彈。1913年1月他回任參謀總部，1914年10月升少將。
body.en: In October 1909 Diaz was appointed chief of staff of the Florence division, and on 1 July 1910 he was promoted colonel and took the 21st Infantry at La Spezia. In May 1912 he went to Libya to replace the commander of the 93rd Infantry and on 20 September was wounded in the shoulder at Sidi Bilal near Zanzur. He returned to the general staff in January 1913 and became a major general in October 1914.

citations.quote: nell'ottobre 1909 il D. lasciò Roma
capo di stato maggiore della divisione di Firenze
Il 1º luglio 1910 fu promosso colonnello e assunse il comando del 21º reggimento
Nel maggio 1912 fu destinato in Libia
comandante del 93º reggimento di fanteria
Il 20 sett. 1912, nello scontro di Sidi Bilal nei pressi di Zanzūr, fu ferito
Nel gennaio 1913, appena guarito, riprese servizio
come capo della segreteria di Pollio
nell'ottobre 1914, promosso maggior generale

heading.zh-Hant: 1915至1917年：最高統帥部與卡索戰線
heading.en: 1915–1917: Supreme Command and the Carso front

body.zh-Hant: 1915年5月最高統帥部成立，迪亞茲負責作戰處；1916年6月27日起指揮第49步兵師，秋季攻勢中奪取聖格拉多高地。1917年4月12日他升任新成立的第23軍團長，8月19至21日參與卡索最後一次攻勢，直到11月任總參謀長為止。
body.en: When the Supreme Command was set up in May 1915 Diaz took charge of its operations department. From 27 June 1916 he commanded the 49th Infantry Division and in the autumn offensive took the San Grado di Merna height. On 12 April 1917 he was given the newly formed XXIII Army Corps and took part in the last Italian offensive on the Carso on 19–21 August, until his appointment as chief of staff in November.

citations.quote: Nel maggio 1915, al momento della costituzione del Comando supremo
il D. vi ebbe la responsabilità del reparto operazioni
il 27 giugno 1916 fu nominato comandante della 49ª divisione di fanteria
conquistando nell'offensiva autunnale l'altura di San Grado di Merna
Il 12 apr. 1917 il D. fu promosso alla testa del XXIII corpo d'armata
poi il 19-21 agosto, nel quadro dell'ultima offensiva italiana sul Carso
L'8 nov. 1917 fu nominato capo di stato maggiore dell'esercito

heading.zh-Hant: 1917至1918年：皮亞韋河防線與維多利奧·威尼托
heading.en: 1917–1918: the Piave line and Vittorio Veneto

body.zh-Hant: 1917年11月8日，迪亞茲接替卡多爾納出任陸軍總參謀長。他整頓最高統帥部，把全軍改編為六個中型集團軍；格拉帕山與皮亞韋河的阻擊戰發生在1917年11至12月，1918年6月義軍在皮亞韋河獲得防禦勝利，隨後是維多利奧·威尼托的最後攻勢。1918年9月他拒絕奧蘭多要他提前進攻的催促。
body.en: On 8 November 1917 Diaz succeeded Cadorna as chief of the army general staff. He reorganised the Supreme Command and redistributed the army into six medium-sized armies. The holding battle on the Grappa and Piave fell in November–December 1917, the victorious defence on the Piave came in June 1918, and the final offensive of Vittorio Veneto followed. In September 1918 he firmly rejected Orlando's calls to attack earlier.

citations.quote: L'8 nov. 1917 fu nominato capo di stato maggiore dell'esercito
il D. riorganizzò il Comando supremo
la redistribuzione dell'esercito in sei armate di medie proporzioni
la battaglia d'arresto sul Grappa e sul Piave nel novembre-dicembre 1917
la vittoriosa resistenza sul Piave nel giugno 1918
l'offensiva finale di Vittorio Veneto
nel settembre 1918 egli respinse energicamente gli inviti di Orlando

heading.zh-Hant: 1919至1921年：總參謀長卸任與陸軍委員會
heading.en: 1919–1921: leaving the general staff and the Army Council

body.zh-Hant: 1919年11月迪亞茲獲授最高榮典勳章，隨後把總參謀長職位交給巴多格里奧，改任陸軍總督察；1920年4月該職被裁撤。1921年2月成立陸軍委員會，他出任副主席並實際主持；同年12月被封為勝利公爵。
body.en: In November 1919 Diaz received the collar of the Annunziata and then handed the post of chief of staff to Badoglio, taking the new post of inspector general of the army; it was abolished in April 1920. In February 1921 the Army Council was created, of which he became vice-president and effective head, and in December that year he was raised to Duke of Victory.

citations.quote: Nel novembre 1919 ricevette il collare della Ss. Annunziata
lasciò la carica di capo di stato maggiore dell'esercito a Badoglio
assunse quella di nuova creazione di ispettore generale dell'esercito
Nell'aprile 1920 un nuovo ordinamento provvisorio dell'esercito
soppresse la carica di ispettore generale
che nel febbraio 1921 trasferì i poteri del capo di stato maggiore
il D. assunse la vicepresidenza e la direzione effettiva
in dicembre fu innalzato alla dignità di duca della Vittoria

heading.en: 1922–1928: Minister of War and marshal

body.zh-Hant: 1922年10月，迪亞茲在政治危機中向首相法克塔保證軍隊將盡其職責，並在10月27至28日夜向國王表達同一態度，隨後入閣擔任墨索里尼第一屆政府的戰爭部長。1924年4月30日他把部長職位交給迪·喬治奧，轉任最高國防委員會副主席；11月4日晉封元帥。1928年2月29日在羅馬逝世。
body.en: In October 1922, amid the political crisis, Diaz assured Prime Minister Facta of the army's loyalty and in the night of 27–28 October repeated the same position to the King, then joined Mussolini's first government as Minister of War. On 30 April 1924 he left the ministry to General Di Giorgio and became vice-president of the Supreme Defence Commission; on 4 November he was named Marshal of Italy. He died in Rome on 29 February 1928.

citations.quote: All'inizio dell'ottobre 1922, mentre la crisi politica precipitava
nella notte tra il 27 e il 28 ottobre il D. ribadì questo atteggiamento
Subito dopo accettò di entrare nel primo governo Mussolini
come ministro della Guerra
il 30 apr. 1924 lasciò il ministero della Guerra al generale A. Di Giorgio
Fu subito nominato vicepresidente del comitato deliberativo
della Commissione suprema di difesa
Il 4 nov. 1924 fu nominato maresciallo d'Italia
Morì a Roma il 29 febbr. 1928.

heading.en: Early career: Eritrea and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 格拉齊亞尼1908年12月前往厄利垂亞，被分到阿迪烏格里的第一土著營。一戰期間他在聖米凱萊山與貝雷塔山一帶作戰，1918年36歲時已是義大利陸軍最年輕的上校；戰後他率第61步兵團駐防馬其頓，該團於1919年8月撤回。
body.en: In December 1908 Graziani reached Eritrea and was assigned to the 1st native battalion at Adi Ugri. In the First World War he distinguished himself at Monte San Michele and the Colle della Beretta, and in 1918, aged 36, he was the youngest colonel in the Italian army; after the war he commanded the 61st Infantry in Macedonia, which was repatriated in August 1919.

citations.quote: nel dicembre 1908 raggiunse la colonia
assegnato al I battaglione indigeni di stanza ad Adi Ugri
si distinse soprattutto nella conquista del monte San Michele
nella battaglia al colle della Beretta
Nel 1918, a 36 anni, era il più giovane colonnello dell'esercito italiano
inviato in Macedonia al comando del 61° fanteria
già nell'agosto 1919, il reggimento fu rimpatriato

heading.en: 1921–1928: the reconquest of Libya

body.zh-Hant: 格拉齊亞尼1921年10月1日抵達利比亞，在當地待了十三年。1922年4月起重新征服行動展開，他以機動縱隊戰術在數月內收復紮維亞等地；1923年12月23日他升准將，同日獲頒國家法西斯黨榮譽黨證。1928年2月25日他在塔格里夫擊敗賽夫·納賽爾兄弟。
body.en: Graziani arrived in Libya on 1 October 1921 and stayed there thirteen years. When the reconquest began in April 1922 he used mobile columns to retake Zawiya and other places within a few months. On 23 December 1923 he was promoted brigadier general and at the same time received the honorary card of the National Fascist Party. On 25 February 1928 he defeated the Sef en-Nasser brothers at Tagrift.

citations.quote: Il G. giunse in Libia il 1° ott. 1921
Vi rimase per tredici anni
nell'aprile 1922
riconquistò in pochi mesi Zavia, el-Azizia, el-Giosc, Giado, Cabao e Nalùt
il 23 dic. 1923, mentre stava per occupare Beni Ulid
ricevette contemporaneamente la promozione a generale di brigata
a Tagrift, il 25 febbr. 1928, conseguì

heading.en: 1928–1932: the Fezzan and Cyrenaica

body.zh-Hant: 費贊戰役歷時三個月，格拉齊亞尼將利比亞南部肅清，並獲任昔蘭尼加副總督。與巴多格里奧合作期間，約十萬昔蘭尼加人被強制遷往集中營，據來源有一半死於營中；1931年1月19日庫夫拉被攻克，9月16日起義領袖穆赫塔爾被絞死。1932年2月2日他升軍團將官。
body.en: The Fezzan campaign lasted three months and cleared southern Libya, and Graziani was named vice-governor of Cyrenaica. Under the plan agreed with Badoglio about 100,000 Cyrenaicans were deported to camps, and the source says half of them died there. Kufra fell on 19 January 1931 and the rebel leader Omar al-Mukhtar was hanged on 16 September 1931. On 2 February 1932 he was promoted corps general.

citations.quote: Con la campagna del Fezzàn, della durata di tre mesi
la nomina a vicegovernatore della Cirenaica
la deportazione di circa 100.000 Cirenaici
la metà dei quali morirono nei lager del deserto
espugnata il 19 genn. 1931 la città santa di Cufra
avvenuta il 16 sett. 1931 nel campo di concentramento di Soluch
Il 2 febbr. 1932 il ministro della Guerra C. Gazzera lo promosse

heading.zh-Hant: 1935至1936年：索馬利亞戰線與衣索比亞戰爭
heading.en: 1935–1936: the Somali front and the Ethiopian war

body.zh-Hant: 1935年2月20日，格拉齊亞尼被通知出任索馬利亞總督兼部隊總司令。1935年10月3日他從南線發動攻勢，1936年1月10日擊潰拉斯德斯塔的部隊；4月15日進攻「興登堡防線」，其後佔領吉吉加與哈拉爾。來源指出他在戰事中使用毒氣。
body.en: On 20 February 1935 Graziani was told he had been named governor of Somalia and commander-in-chief of the troops. On 3 October 1935 he attacked on the southern front, and on 10 January 1936 he defeated the army of Ras Desta. On 15 April 1936 he attacked the "Hindenburg line" and then took Jijiga and Harar. The source says he was the first to use gas in the campaign.

citations.quote: Il 20 febbr. 1935 il capo del fascismo gli comunicò
governatore della Somalia e comandante in capo delle truppe
Il 3 ott. 1935, mentre le armate del generale De Bono varcavano il Mareb
il 10 genn. 1936 il G. andava incontro all'armata di ras Destà Damtù
Ma il 15 apr. 1936 era in grado di attaccare la "linea Hindenburg"
conquistò Giggiga e poi Harar
Fu il primo a impiegare i gas per rallentare la marcia di ras Destà

heading.en: 1936–1938: Viceroy of Ethiopia

body.zh-Hant: 格拉齊亞尼因戰功獲元帥杖與內戈利侯爵頭銜，並在阿迪斯阿貝巴接任衣索比亞副王。1937年2月19日他在典禮上遇襲，其後的報復造成大量死亡；1937年5月21至27日，他下令的德布雷利巴諾斯修道院屠殺發生。他於1938年1月10日離開阿迪斯阿貝巴。
body.en: For his victories Graziani received the marshal's baton and the title of Marquis of Neghelli, and in Addis Ababa he took over the post of Viceroy of Ethiopia. On 19 February 1937 he was wounded in an attack during a ceremony and a savage reprisal followed. The Debra Libanos massacre, which he ordered, was carried out between 21 and 27 May 1937. He left Addis Ababa on 10 January 1938.

citations.quote: il bastone da maresciallo e il titolo nobiliare di marchese di Neghelli
l'ambitissimo incarico di viceré d'Etiopia
Il 19 febbr. 1937, mentre il G. assisteva a una cerimonia
la rappresaglia, che fu selvaggia e indiscriminata
ordinò al generale P. Maletti di passare per le armi tutti i monaci
Maletti portò a termine la sua missione tra il 21 e il 27 maggio 1937
il G. lasciò Addis Abeba il 10 genn. 1938

heading.zh-Hant: 1939至1941年：陸軍參謀長與北非戰役
heading.en: 1939–1941: army chief of staff and the North African campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1939年11月3日，格拉齊亞尼從廣播得知自己被任命為陸軍參謀長。二戰初期他被派往利比亞接替巴爾博，1940年9月13日越過埃及邊界，12月9日韋維爾反攻使五個義大利師潰敗。1941年2月8日他請求解除職務，被召回義大利。
body.en: On 3 November 1939 Graziani learned from the radio that he had been named chief of staff of the army. Early in the Second World War he was sent to Libya to replace Balbo and on 13 September 1940 crossed the Egyptian frontier. Wavell's counter-offensive of 9 December shattered five Italian divisions. On 8 February 1941 he asked to be relieved and was recalled to Italy.

citations.quote: apprese di essere stato nominato capo di stato maggiore dell'esercito
fu mandato in Libia a sostituire Balbo
il 13 sett. 1940, a varcare la frontiera egiziana
il 9 dicembre lanciava la controffensiva
in soli tre giorni polverizzava cinque divisioni italiane
Quando, l'8 febbr. 1941, dopo aver perso l'intera Cirenaica

heading.zh-Hant: 社會共和國時期與戰後
heading.en: The Social Republic and the post-war years

body.zh-Hant: 格拉齊亞尼在薩洛共和國擔任戰爭部長，名義上統領「利古里亞」集團軍。1945年4月29日他被轉交美軍，1950年5月2日被判處十九年徒刑，因赦免數月後獲釋；1955年1月11日於羅馬逝世。
body.en: In the Salò Republic Graziani held the Ministry of War and was nominally at the head of the "Liguria" army. On 29 April 1945 he was handed over to the Americans; on 2 May 1950 he was sentenced to nineteen years in prison but was freed months later through amnesties. He died in Rome on 11 January 1955.

citations.quote: affidandogli il ministero della Guerra
Nominalmente il G. era a capo dell'armata "Liguria"
fu trasferito il 29 apr. 1945
al comando del IV corpo d'armata corazzato americano
il 2 maggio 1950, fu condannato a 19 anni di carcere
Si spense a Roma l'11 genn. 1955.

heading.en: 1909–1921: cavalry and the Tank Corps

body.zh-Hant: 巴頓1909年畢業於西點軍校，分發第15騎兵團。1912年他代表美國參加斯德哥爾摩奧運現代五項，名列第五，並赴法國索米爾騎兵學校進修。1916至1917年他任潘興的副官，隨墨西哥懲罰遠征軍行動；1917至1918年成為美國坦克兵第一名成員，1918至1921年指揮第304坦克旅。
body.en: Patton graduated from West Point in 1909 and was assigned to the 15th Cavalry. In 1912 he competed for the United States in the modern pentathlon at Stockholm, finishing fifth, and attended the French cavalry school at Saumur. From 1916 to 1917 he was aide-de-camp to Pershing on the Mexican Punitive Expedition; in 1917–18 he was the first member of the American Tank Corps, and from 1918 to 1921 he commanded the 304th Tank Brigade.

heading.en: 1921–1941: the inter-war years and armour

body.zh-Hant: 1921至1922年，巴頓在邁爾堡指揮第3騎兵團第一中隊；1932年畢業於陸軍戰爭學院，1938年升上校並指揮第5騎兵團。1940年他升准將，指揮第2裝甲師的第2裝甲旅；1941年升少將，改任第2裝甲師師長，至1942年。
body.en: In 1921–22 Patton commanded the First Squadron of the Third Cavalry at Fort Myer; he graduated from the Army War College in 1932, and in 1938 became a colonel commanding the Fifth Cavalry. In 1940 he was promoted brigadier general and led the Second Armored Brigade of the Second Armored Division; in 1941 he became a major general and commanded the Second Armored Division until 1942.

heading.en: 1942–1943: North Africa and Sicily

body.zh-Hant: 1942年巴頓指揮第1裝甲軍，隨後指揮西部特遣隊參與盟軍登陸及北非戰役，轉任第2軍。1943年他升中將，把第2軍交給布萊德雷，並準備西西里入侵，擔任第7集團軍指揮官；西西里行動「Husky」始於1943年7月10日。1943年11月傳出他掌摑戰鬥疲勞士兵的事件。
body.en: In 1942 Patton commanded the I Armored Corps and then the Western Task Force during the Allied landings and the North African campaign, and moved to command of II Corps. In 1943 he was promoted lieutenant general, handed II Corps to Omar Bradley and prepared for the invasion of Sicily, commanding the Seventh Army; operation "Husky" began on 10 July 1943. In November 1943 the press reported that he had slapped soldiers suffering from battle fatigue.

heading.en: 1944–1945: the Third Army

body.zh-Hant: 1944年巴頓奉命赴英國，準備入侵法國時接掌第3集團軍；1944至1945年他指揮第3集團軍，推進穿越法國、德國、捷克斯洛伐克與奧地利。1944年4月他在納茨福德的演說曾威脅其職務。1945年他轉任第15集團軍司令，並於12月21日在德國海德堡逝世。
body.en: In 1944 Patton was ordered to England to take command of the Third Army in preparation for the invasion of France; in 1944–45 he commanded it in the drive across France, Germany, Czechoslovakia and Austria. His remarks in a speech at Knutsford in April 1944 threatened his career. In 1945 he became commander of the Fifteenth Army and he died at Heidelberg, Germany, on 21 December 1945.

heading.en: 1911–1918: military aviator and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 阿諾德1886年生於費城，在西點軍校畢業後被分到步兵並派往菲律賓。1911年他成為軍事飛行員，在俄亥俄州的萊特兄弟學校受訓；1912年10月他成為首位麥凱獎得主，因成功用空中偵察找到一支騎兵部隊。一戰期間他留在華盛頓，負責飛機生產與動員。
body.en: Arnold was born in Philadelphia in 1886 and after West Point was assigned to the infantry and sent to the Philippines. He became a military pilot in 1911 after training at the Wright brothers' school in Ohio, and in October 1912 became the first Mackay Trophy winner by using aerial reconnaissance to locate a cavalry troop. During the First World War he stayed in Washington overseeing aircraft production and mobilization.

heading.zh-Hant: 1924至1938年：空軍勤務與航空兵團副團長
heading.en: 1924–1938: the air service and the assistant chief's post

body.zh-Hant: 1924年阿諾德被調回華盛頓擔任航空勤務處資訊主任；1926年米切爾受軍事法庭審判時他出庭作證支持米切爾。1934年他率領十架B-10轟炸機完成華盛頓與阿拉斯加費爾班克斯的往返飛行，贏得第二座麥凱獎。1936年他任航空兵團副團長，1938年9月航空兵團團長韋斯托弗墜機身亡後，他接任團長。
body.en: In 1924 Arnold was called back to Washington as chief of information of the air service, and at Mitchell's 1926 court-martial he testified on his behalf. In 1934 he earned his second Mackay Trophy commanding ten B-10 bombers on a round trip between Washington and Fairbanks, Alaska. In 1936 he became assistant chief of the Air Corps, and when Chief Oscar Westover died in a plane crash in September 1938, Arnold became chief.

heading.en: 1941–1946: the Army Air Forces

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月20日，航空勤務部隊改稱美國陸軍航空軍，阿諾德把它分編為各有任務與戰區的航空軍。他推動B-17與B-29的研發，並支持戰略轟炸、杜立德空襲東京與對日本的燃燒彈攻擊。1945年1月19日，距晉升五星上將不到一個月，他首度心臟病發；他在1946年6月退役。
body.en: On 20 June 1941 the air service was renamed the United States Army Air Force, and Arnold organized it into smaller air forces, each with a specific task and theater. He pushed the development of the B-17 and B-29 and supported strategic bombing, the Doolittle raid on Tokyo and firebombing in Japan. He had his first heart attack on 19 January 1945, less than a month after his promotion to five-star General of the Army, and he retired in June 1946.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰期間的空中戰役與作戰指導
heading.en: Direction of air campaigns in the Second World War

body.zh-Hant: 阿諾德在二戰期間統領陸軍航空軍，並非前線單一戰場的指揮官，而是以空軍首長身分主導空中作戰的整體指導。依 Centennial of Flight 所載，他推動研發 B-17 與 B-29 等重型遠程轟炸機，用於大規模戰略轟炸戰役；他也支持杜立德空襲東京及對日本本土的燃燒彈轟炸。
body.en: During the Second World War Arnold led the Army Air Forces not as a front-line theatre commander but as the air chief directing air operations overall. Centennial of Flight records that he pushed the B-17 and B-29 heavy long-range bombers for large-scale strategic bombing campaigns and supported the Doolittle raid on Tokyo and the firebombing of Japan.

before.zh-Hant: 阿諾德在二戰期間統領陸軍航空軍，並非前線單一戰場的指揮官，而是以空軍首長身分主導空中作戰的整體指導。依 Centennial of Flight 所載，他推動研發 B-17 與 B-29 等重型遠程轟炸機，用於大規模戰略轟炸戰役；他也支持杜立德空襲東京及對日本本土的燃燒彈轟炸。另據 Generals.dk 服役表，他自1944年4月6日至1945年7月16日出任第二十航空軍司令，該軍即對日戰略轟炸的主力。
before.en: During the Second World War Arnold led the Army Air Forces not as a front-line theatre commander but as the air chief directing air operations overall. Centennial of Flight records that he pushed the B-17 and B-29 heavy long-range bombers for large-scale strategic bombing campaigns and supported the Doolittle raid on Tokyo and the firebombing of Japan. Generals.dk lists him as commanding general of the Twentieth Air Force from 6 April 1944 to 16 July 1945.
